home.heroTitle: Joint is a metaphor for the weakest connection in an argument.
home.method3Body: Bench refers metaphorically to the panel of AI models, not a physical seat.
newDebate.asOfProvenance: As-of is the point in time whose known facts the debate should use.
billing.checkout.subscribeAndPay: Romanian must read exactly 'Comandă cu obligație de plată' (Terms §12). Elsewhere use the local legal wording for an order with an obligation to pay.
billing.plans.PLUS.name: Plus, Pro and Max are product names: keep them. Translate only 'Free'.
billing.pricing.currencyNote: Shown under the plan cards. The cards show prices in the currency of the place shown above them (the country the visitor chose, or the one they connect from); the checkout prices in the billing country's currency, which may differ. Do not name a currency here.
billing.pricing.taxIncluded: Under a plan's price, which already includes the tax (Terms §12). {rate} is the tax rate as a number, {country} the visitor's country name. Keep the order and punctuation of billing.checkout.taxLabel's brackets.
billing.pricing.noTaxAdded: Under a plan's price when the visitor's country adds no tax to it; {country} is the country name. Say only that no tax is added, never that the service is tax-free.
billing.pricing.chooseCountry: Shown on a paid plan card in place of its price while no country is known. Terms §12: prices are shown only with tax, so this asks for the country (the selector above the cards); never mention a price before tax.
billing.pricing.enterPostalCode: Shown on a paid plan card for the US and Canada until a postal code is given: their tax depends on the state or province. Use the word the checkout's billing.checkout.postalCode uses.
billing.pricing.showPrices: The button under the country (and, in the US and Canada, postal code) fields above the plan cards; it reloads the prices for that place.
home.pricingCopyTaxIncluded: {price} is the lowest paid plan's monthly price with the visitor's tax already in it (Terms §12).
home.pricingCopyChoose: The landing's price line when the visitor's place cannot be priced yet (unknown country, the US or Canada before a postal code, the tax service not answering). Names no price; the 'See the plans' link follows it.
billing.consent.renewal: Keep the address dezbatere.ro/cancel as written. NETOPIA Payments is a brand name; keep it. {total} is the monthly price with tax; keep it in the sentence. This sentence is a legal agreement (the card kept for monthly payments): translate it faithfully, add nothing.
billing.checkout.cardNote: NETOPIA Payments is a brand name; keep it. The sentence says the card is typed on NETOPIA's own page, not ours.
billing.checkout.continueToCard: This button places the paid order before NETOPIA's payment page opens. It reads 'Subscribe and pay' in every language (Terms §12): Romanian exactly 'Abonați-vă și plătiți'; every other language uses the button text its own Terms §12 gives.
billing.checkout.total: {day} is a day of the month; English shows it as an ordinal (29th), other languages as a number: word the sentence so a plain number reads naturally.
billing.checkout.county: The Romanian judet (or Bucharest); in Romanian use 'Județ'.
billing.subscription.upgradeQuote: {recurringTotal} is the new plan's full monthly price with tax; keep it in the sentence.
billing.subscription.upgradeConfirm: This button places a paid order. Romanian should use the Terms §12 'obligation to pay' wording (e.g. 'Comandă cu obligație de plată'); elsewhere use the local legal wording for an order with an obligation to pay.
billing.subscription.upgradePay: This button places a paid order ({amount} is the sum paid now). Romanian reads 'Comandă cu obligație de plată ({amount})' (Terms §12); elsewhere use the local legal wording for an order with an obligation to pay.
billing.checkout.taxLabel: {tax} is the tax amount, {taxName} its name (VAT, MwSt., TVA), {rate} a number: keep all four, in the order that reads naturally.
billing.checkout.doNotPayAgain: Shown after the waiting screen gives up: the payment may still be in progress, so the person must not pay twice.
billing.subscription.withdrawHint: {date} is the LAST day the person may still withdraw (that day included), in their own calendar.
billing.subscription.withdrawWindowClose: Keep '14-day': it is the legal withdrawal period. Say that it may also not apply where the person lives.
billing.subscription.stepUpExpired: The password and code were right; only the confirmation expired or was already used. Do not ask the person to check their password.
billing.subscription.upgradeInProgress: An earlier upgrade payment is still waiting for the bank or the payment provider; nothing new was charged.
billing.checkout.erasurePending: The person asked to delete their account (a 7-day wait). They can cancel that deletion in Settings.
billing.subscription.downgradeNotAvailab: The renewal payment for the next month has already started at the current plan, so no lower plan can be chosen until it has gone through (minutes, or up to 3 days during an outage). Nothing failed and nothing was charged extra: do not say it failed, and name no date.
billing.subscription.downgradeConfirm: {price} is the lower plan's price BEFORE tax, so keep '+ tax' (or the local short form); {date} is the day the lower plan starts.
billing.subscription.withdrawOwnerReview: A refund made outside the site touched one of the payments; a person checks what is still due. Keep 'within 14 days' (the legal refund deadline).
billing.card.countryRefused: Nothing was taken from the new card, and the plan keeps its old card. Name no country and no plan, and do not mention a hold.
billing.card.tryAgainShortly: The new card was not saved because a payment on the plan (a renewal or an upgrade) is still waiting for its outcome. Nothing failed: do not say the card was refused. Keep 'in an hour'.
billing.card.notSaved: The bank accepted the check, but no card was kept for the monthly payments. Nothing was charged and nothing changed. Ask the person to try again and, if it happens again, to use another card; do not say the card was refused, and do not mention wallets (NETOPIA never offers them on recurring payments).
billing.withdrawPage.byEmail: {email} is the company's contact address. Keep 'model withdrawal form': it is the form attached to the confirmation email.
billing.subscription.renewalProcessing: Shown while a renewal is retried after a short outage at the payment or tax service (up to 3 days). No payment has failed: do not say it failed, and name no date.
billing.cancelPage.confirmLede: The page cannot know the plan's state, so it states both cases before the button: with a payment overdue the plan ends at once; otherwise it runs to the end of the paid month. Keep both.
billing.cancelPage.done: Promise no date here: the confirmation email names the exact day access ends.
chrome.footer.dbipCredit: Keep exactly 'IP Geolocation by DB-IP' in every locale: DB-IP's free licence requires this credit text.
chrome.footer.visa: Brand names: keep 'NETOPIA Payments', 'Visa' and 'Mastercard' as they are.
legal.notice.s01.seller: {company} is the company's legal name, filled in from the legal notice's facts; keep both.
legal.notice.s04.payments: NETOPIA Payments is a brand name; keep it.
legal.archive.textId: {id} is the first 12 characters of the text's fingerprint (letters a–f and digits); copy it unchanged.
legal.archive.title: {version} is a document version number such as 2.0; keep it as a number.
chrome.release.newerVersion: Shown in a thin line under the top bar, next to a Reload button, on a page that was opened before the site was updated. 'Site' means this website. Keep it neutral: the site may have been moved forward or back, so never say 'newer' or 'new version'. Plain words; no technical terms such as build, release or deploy.
chrome.release.reload: A button that reloads the page (the browser's reload). Use the usual short word for reloading or refreshing a page.
chrome.release.madeByNewer: Shown instead of a public debate this older page cannot display, because a newer version of this website made it. 'Site' means this website.
runFailure.CHOICE_GONE: Shown for a question that waited in line while the website was updated; one of the options the person picked (for example an AI model) is no longer offered. 'Site' means this website. 'Quota' is the person's plan quota of debates, not money: say it did not count against it. Use the same word for 'quota' as the rest of the catalogue.
runFailure.SET_ASIDE: Shown for a debate that was stopped partway because the website was being updated (not the person's fault, not a fault of the question). 'Update' means an update of this website. 'Quota' is the person's plan quota of debates, not money; use the same word as runFailure.CHOICE_GONE and billing: say this debate did not count against it.
newDebate.freePublicNotice: A legal-weight notice shown before a Free person asks. Translate faithfully: say that both the question and its debate are public, and tell the person not to include personal details. Add nothing, soften nothing. Use the catalogue's own name for the Free plan and its usual form of address.
